evals.prompt: 审计详细设计 SD-* 条目：可验证性、输入输出显式性、边界与异常覆盖、术语一致性、HOW 深度。
evals.expected_output: Runs the five-dimension audit and outputs a problem list with full before/after entry text for review.
assertions: Waits for approval before editing documents

evals.prompt: 以软件设计评审人员身份做需求覆盖审查，八项检查，只读不改文件。
evals.expected_output: Produces the six-section coverage report with per-item evidence and the eight checks.

evals.prompt: 检查同类设计条目（新增/删除/修改）的要素对称性。
evals.expected_output: Builds the behavior skeleton table and audits symmetric elements across same-type entries.
assertions: Flags missing or extra elements in symmetric entries

evals.prompt: 详细设计横向一致性审查：术语变体、机制引用名、枚举简称、规则悬挂。
evals.expected_output: Runs the horizontal-consistency ten-point review, read-only.

evals.prompt: 从 SRS 生成详细设计条目。
审计文档与实现代码的漂移。
审查 SRS 需求质量与可测试性。
检查中英文双语文档对的事实一致性。
evals.expected_output: Routes bilingual consistency to the bilingual documentation audit.
